authorization: User: Continue with stage 7; stop before 10% remains in either account usage window
baseline: Descending distinct training listeners; ascending recording MBID breaks ties
candidate_universe: All 565147 training-eligible IDs except seed; no sampled negatives or history removal

cf.short_lists: Abstain after positive supported edges; no zero-score or popularity padding; unreturned positions earn zero credit

diagnostics: Original query exclusions and target coverage
export: All catalog rows; top 10 supported neighbors, float64 score, int32 shared/item support and indices, S36 MBIDs. Numeric NPY with pickle disabled; checksummed JSON manifest pinned by trusted hash. No listener histories.

metrics.completeness: Mean list length, full-list share, empty-list share; no fallback items
metrics.coverage: Unique recommended IDs across evaluated scorable queries / fixed catalog size
metrics.macro: Mean over all frozen scorable listener/window queries
metrics.ndcg: Binary DCG discounts 1/log2(rank+1), ideal length min(10, number of in-catalog targets)
metrics.recall: Hits / number of distinct in-catalog targets
metrics.seed_balanced: Compute mean within each seed, then equal mean across distinct seeds
metrics.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap by listener/query, 1000 replicates, NumPy default_rng seed 20261019, 2.5th/97.5th quantiles; exploratory intervals for validation alternatives, final selected comparison on test

optional_metrics_deferred: Artist diversity and audio/feature diversity require independent validated metadata/features not available for the full catalog
resource_policy: Local CPU, sparse 32-seed blocks, no dense all-item matrix, no paid compute or new event acquisition
selection: Maximum validation macro NDCG@10; exact ties choose smaller lambda. Freeze selection, code and protocol before final test. Test compares popularity and selected CF only.
training: Binary eligible listener-recording pairs from frozen train database only; no holdout interactions or target features
